summary: Completed E2E testing for Under Street ecommerce (MVP). Backend: 19/19 pytest suite passed (products CRUD/filter/sort, orders with shipping math incl. free-ship threshold, mock-pay happy/duplicate, admin stats/orders/status-update, auth via Bearer header). Frontend: home hero 'NOT FOR EVERYONE', shop grid (12 products), hoodies filter (3), product detail with size selection, add-to-cart, cart drawer open+qty-inc+subtotal update, unauth prompts on /admin and /my-orders all verified working.

integration_issues.issue: Navigating directly to /checkout after add-to-cart shows empty cart ('CARRITO VACÍO'). CartContext appears to be memory-only; no localStorage persistence. Cart→Drawer→Checkout button flow works (items preserved), but a user who refreshes the page or uses back/forward loses their cart. Consider persisting cart to localStorage.

action_items: Optional: persist CartContext to localStorage so cart survives page reload / direct navigation. Minor UX improvement; not blocking MVP.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: admin endpoints accept any authenticated user (role not enforced). Aligns with the stated 'single-owner all users are admin' design but worth noting.
auth/session sets cookies with SameSite=None; Secure=True which is correct for cross-site preview domain.
All mongo queries correctly exclude _id via projection. Good.
mock-pay endpoint is unauthenticated — acceptable for mocked flow, but could be tightened post-MVP.
test_credentials: Seeded MongoDB session token used: ui_session_8fd07dc86be94036adf1313261da4fef (user_id ui-test-* with role=admin). For new runs, use the mongosh snippet in /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
seed_data_creation: Inserted test users/sessions in MongoDB for Bearer auth. 12 products are seeded automatically on backend startup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully green. Frontend flows OK except cart is not persisted to localStorage — direct /checkout navigation loses cart state. Place-order via cart drawer's checkout button works end-to-end (first run reached /checkout and MP modal). All required data-testid attributes are present.
